info.title: API-DocTest-List Realestate Listings Agents-v2-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API allows users to access a comprehensive list of real estate listings associated with specific agents. This endpoint provides vital information including property details, pricing, and availability, making it essential for real estate professionals and potential buyers. Typical use cases include searching for properties listed by favorite agents or comparing offerings among different agents. Developers can integrate this API to enhance real estate platforms, enabling better decision-making and streamlined property searches.

get.summary: Retrieve listings by a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all the property listings associated with a particular agent. Use the agent's ID to get accurate results for their listings.

requestBody.description: Payload for retrieving listings by agent. This request body specifies the parameters needed to filter or sort the listings based on the agent's credentials and preferences.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of agent listings.
